conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Hey, I’m okay, I guess. Just had a bit of a tough moment when a loud noise startled me, and it brought back a wave of anxiety. My heart raced, and I felt this tightening in my chest.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: That sounds really overwhelming. How did you manage that anxiety in the moment?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: I didn’t really manage it, to be honest. I just kind of froze up and felt trapped in my thoughts. I kept thinking about how I can’t seem to shake that feeling of danger, and it makes everything seem too much to handle.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: It sounds difficult to feel that way. Can you describe what specific thoughts were going through your mind when you felt trapped?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: I kept replaying that moment when things went wrong, thinking about how everything could go sideways again. It’s like a loop in my head, making me feel like I’m still in that situation. That thought just grips me, leaving me feeling tense and on edge.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: That sounds really challenging. How did that loop of thoughts affect your feelings or behavior right after that moment?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: After that moment, I just felt this heaviness weighing me down. I wanted to retreat into myself, avoiding any interaction. I didn’t even feel like going out, just wanted to stay where it felt a bit safer, even if that meant isolating myself.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: It seems like the heaviness really impacted how you engaged with your surroundings. Did you notice any changes in your physical sensations during that time?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Yeah, it was hard to ignore the way my body felt. My hands were shaky, and there was a tension in my shoulders that just wouldn’t let up. I felt like I was holding my breath, almost like my body was instinctively bracing for something bad to happen again.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: Those physical sensations sound really intense. What did you do, if anything, to help ease the tension in your body afterward?
